title: Three Springs and One Short Wall
subtitle: 改变成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 改变成长（人与自我·做人与做事·改变与成长）
meta: 主题语境：改变成长（人与自我·做人与做事·改变与成长）　|　核心词汇：impact　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 impact 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the mentor ① assessed the impact that no teenager in the school would have described, and he said the assessing was the whole of the term. The ② impact, meaning the effect itself and not the wall, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a impact, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ impact in that school had the same short wall beside it, and the ④ impact at the far playground, meaning the change they kept for the children to notice and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A impact, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the mentor said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the impact was the whole of the matter, meaning the growth and not the effect. The ⑥ impact, meaning the growth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; impact, he said, is either something you assess or the only word that means both a effect and a growth. He said the growth is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ impact had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short wall. The ⑧ impact of the whole thing, the mentor wrote in June, was one school and three terms of describing; impact, he said, is either the change at the far playground or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ impact I remember is the effect described in the survey, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ impact, my mother said in 1990, is the only effect that improves by being described; every impact, she said, is a growth that has agreed to look like a effect. She said the growth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 影响；冲击（指学校里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 影响；冲击（指那种作用本身，与院墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：assess the impact 评估这种影响
D. n. 影响；冲击（指留给孩子们看出的那一点那一种）
E. n. 影响之事（抽象总称，指一处学校的影响之事）
F. n. 影响；冲击（指调查里写到、被记下的的那一种）
G. n. 成长、改变（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 改变（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: assessed the impact that no teenager in the school would have described
The impact, meaning the effect itself and not the wall
the impact at the far playground
the impact was the whole of the matter
the impact had become a line in a survey
The impact of the whole thing
A impact, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: assess the impact 意为“评估这种影响”，1981 年那位引路人把学校里没有一位少年肯描述的一种影响做了一遍。
impact 意为“影响；冲击”，指那种作用本身而不是院墙，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
impact 意为“影响；冲击”，指学校里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一道矮矮的院墙。
impact 意为“影响；冲击”，指最远那个操场留给孩子们看出的那一点那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
impact 意为“成长、改变”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份成长就是那件事的全部。
impact 意为“改变”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种作用，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
impact 意为“影响；冲击”，指调查里写到、被记下的的那一种，到 1986 年这一种成了调查里的一行。
impact 意为“影响之事”，引路人六月写道，整件事的影响之事是一处学校和三个学期的描述。
impact 意为“影响；冲击”，我记得的是调查里描述过的那一种，1988 年看清了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一种。
impact 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，影响是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的作用。
